scope: A0.5R ratifies the semantic authority of the existing continental reference field only. It does not select final global heat-flow architecture C, ocean model parameters, ShellSet q-limits, or runtime values.

producer_lineage.authorial_selection: The B-v2 authorial ratification explicitly places per-class reference_surface_heat_flow_mW_m2 under CONTINENTAL_THERMAL_STRUCTURAL_DOMAINS, alongside reference lithosphere thickness and soft area target fractions. The realization is RATIFIED_FOR_T0_MATERIALIZATION.

assignment_inputs: canonical geography land_ocean_mask (coastline_mask is not used to assign thermal classes)
canonical boundary vector edge row/column/axis for adjacency lookup
canonical kinematic relative_normal_velocity_m_per_year and segment length_m
authorial soft area target fractions and deterministic stable cell-ID tie breaks
class_assignment.method: Positive signed boundary-normal kinematic demand accumulates extension support on adjacent land cells; negative signed demand accumulates convergence support. The producer uses hot_share=0.10 and cold_share=0.55 of continental area as soft targets. Deterministic shortest-path support ranks coherent hot/extended and quiet/stable land classes; the remaining land receives NORMAL. Thermal classes are not selected from Earth province tags, white noise, crust thickness, or coastline_mask. The coastline mask is used separately for physical crust transition classification, not this thermal class assignment.

value_materialization.support_expression: land & (thermal_id == thermal); outside support initialized UNKNOWN (NaN)

provenance_metadata: authorial candidate ID and RATIFIED_FOR_T0_MATERIALIZATION status
canonical geography, partition and kinematics hashes
field package hash and normalized per-field hash
thermal IDs, area fractions, reference heat-flow and thickness values in realization manifest
specialist materialization ledger with upstream field hash and continental-only/incomplete-global status
producer_lineage.lineage_limit: The value map is explicitly ratified. Its cellwise support is deterministically realized from the ratified class template and canonical geography/kinematics; the producer does not contain an observational dataset or thermal inversion for the values.

value_provenance.basis: Values are explicit authorial class parameters in the ratified B-v2 T0 realization and are deterministically materialized. They are not imported present-day Earth heat-flow observations and are not derived from crustal thickness.
value_provenance.physical_law_claim: No claim that the constants are measurements, a universal continental law, or a unique geotherm solution.
value_provenance.uncertainty: The authorial ratification says authorial choices are not ensemble axes and sampling is not required for ratification. No numerical uncertainty distribution is provided for this field. Preserve its thermal-class identity and provenance; do not invent uncertainty magnitudes. Model uncertainty for downstream geotherms remains separate.

explicit_authorial_evidence: The ratified B-v2 artifact places reference_surface_heat_flow_mW_m2 directly in CONTINENTAL_THERMAL_STRUCTURAL_DOMAINS, with the classes and units represented explicitly.
The materializer's comments identify this as a ranked, spatially coherent T0 realization based on soft area envelopes.
The specialist report says 'continental domain references materialized' and separately says continental geotherm profiles and model-derived heat flow beyond ratified references remain pending.
The field is included in the upstream physical field package and its normalized hash is carried into materialization/runtime reports.
existing_semantic_authority.nonblocking_wording: The noun 'reference' limits the claim: it denotes a prescribed T0 reference/boundary state, not a measured heat-flow map or a complete global flux solution. The term does not prohibit use as the continental prescribed physical reference boundary.
preexisting_downstream_text: R6_T0_B_PANGAEA_LIKE_V2_SPECIALIST_MATERIALIZATION.json: global_heat_flow marks continental references present, ocean/global field missing, complete node support false, and per-node lineage not assembled.
R6_T0_B_PANGAEA_LIKE_V2_SPECIALIST_MATERIALIZATION.json: continental geotherm profiles and model-derived heat flow beyond ratified references remain pending.

R6_T0_B_PANGAEA_LIKE_V2_RUNTIME_BINDING_AND_INPUT_READJUDICATION.json: lists the field among materialized ARCANA state but does not consume/project it into FEG heat_flow; heat-flow and qArray routing remain open.
R6_PRE_ORBDATA_HEAT_FLOW_SCIENTIFIC_REQUIREMENTS and A0.4/A0.5 reports correctly left its precise semantic role open before this ratification.
existing_semantic_authority.negative_authority: No inspected authority says this field must be calibration-only, validation-only, Earth-derived, or forbidden as a prescribed continental T0 reference.

A_PRESCRIBED_T0_PHYSICAL_REFERENCE.compatibility_with_producer: COMPATIBLE. Authorial ratification supplies per-class reference surface heat-flow values as part of the T0 continental thermal structural domains.
A_PRESCRIBED_T0_PHYSICAL_REFERENCE.compatibility_with_contracts: COMPATIBLE. 'Reference' and 'beyond ratified references' preserve a baseline reference boundary while leaving richer geotherm/model outputs pending.
A_PRESCRIBED_T0_PHYSICAL_REFERENCE.new_physical_assumptions: No new numerical or constitutive assumption is introduced; the existing authorial reference values are semantically clarified as prescribed T0 continental boundary/reference state. This does not claim observational truth or unique subsurface thermal structure.
A_PRESCRIBED_T0_PHYSICAL_REFERENCE.pre_orbdata_consequence: Provides a governed continental branch input on its existing support. It does not complete ocean heat flow, FEG projection, qLim governance, or runtime routing.

B_CALIBRATION_TARGET.compatibility_with_producer: Possible as a use of reference values, but not the best fit: the producer stores the values as a T0 field and the ratification lists them as selected class parameters; no calibrated model, objective function, observation target, or fitting procedure is specified.
B_CALIBRATION_TARGET.compatibility_with_contracts: Not required by current contracts; would reinterpret explicit T0 reference selections as targets for an unselected continental model.
B_CALIBRATION_TARGET.new_physical_assumptions: Would require choosing a calibration model, loss/weights and target meaning not present in authority.
B_CALIBRATION_TARGET.pre_orbdata_consequence: Would not supply continental q until calibration/model configuration exists; current blocker remains.

C_VALIDATION_REFERENCE_ONLY.compatibility_with_producer: Possible but inconsistent with the ratification's placement of values as selected T0 thermal-domain parameters and the materializer's use to populate the T0 field.
C_VALIDATION_REFERENCE_ONLY.compatibility_with_contracts: No contract restricts the field to validation-only; it would demote already ratified T0 content without evidence.
C_VALIDATION_REFERENCE_ONLY.new_physical_assumptions: Requires an independent continental model as sole physical authority, not yet selected.
C_VALIDATION_REFERENCE_ONLY.pre_orbdata_consequence: Continental physical flux would remain missing pending that independent model.

D_OTHER.rationale: The source/ratification supports a synthetic authored T0 reference boundary field; no evidence requires diagnostic-only or proxy-only semantics.

noncontradictory_scope_limits: The global heat-flow payload remains missing; a partial continental reference is not a global field.
FEG support/projection and per-node lineage are not materialized.
The 'derived_fields' manifest grouping describes materialization packaging and does not overrule the explicit authorial primitive selection that supplies the class reference values.
A later thermal specialist may produce geotherm profiles or additional/model-derived heat-flow fields beyond this reference; that is not a mandate to discard this reference boundary.
A0.5's prior unresolved conclusion is superseded for this field's continental semantic role only; global A/B/C architecture remains open.

intended_semantics: authored synthetic T0 physical reference field
prescribed continental surface heat-flow boundary/reference state
authority limited to its producing continental thermal-class/cell support
no higher spatial resolution than the producing cell/class support
thermal-class identity, input lineage, and uncertainty/provenance status preserved
FEG projection is NUMERICAL_DERIVED_SUPPORT only and creates no new physical resolution
not derived merely from crustal thickness

proposed_ratification.authorization_basis: The user explicitly instructed that, absent contradictory authority, this exact semantic ratification be prepared. Existing B-v2 authorial ratification explicitly selected the per-class reference surface heat-flow values.

effect_on_existing_values.operation: Semantic authority clarification only; the three existing thermal-class references and all generated cells remain unchanged.

spatial_authority.native_support: 180x360 cell-centered support on land cells assigned a continental thermal class.
spatial_authority.class_support: COLD_STABLE, NORMAL, HOT_EXTENDED; each class assigned by deterministic T0 ranking using canonical geography and boundary kinematic support under ratified soft area targets.
spatial_authority.outside_support: UNKNOWN, including ocean cells; no global authority is asserted.
spatial_authority.resolution: Native field/class support only. No claim to subcell or FEG resolution.

uncertainty_authority.what_is_governed: Deterministic class identity, authored reference values, generating policy and provenance.
uncertainty_authority.what_is_not_governed: No numeric uncertainty interval/covariance for these references and no thermal-model posterior.
uncertainty_authority.policy: Preserve provenance and class-conditioned uncertainty status. Do not fabricate intervals, Earth-derived uncertainty, or ensemble members. Downstream geotherm/model uncertainty remains separately governed.

feg_projection_status.required_policy: Project only onto FEG nodes with homogeneous incident continental support; retain source-cell IDs and weights/method. Mixed ocean/continent or UNKNOWN incident support remains UNKNOWN unless a separately ratified interface policy resolves it.
feg_projection_status.exact_zero_warning: ShellSet interprets exact zero heat flow as needQ sentinel; projection/adapter must not silently convert UNKNOWN or a legitimate zero to an ordinary input value.

downstream_architecture_implications.continental_side: The continental reference branch is semantically authorized as authored T0 boundary/reference state on native support.

downstream_architecture_implications.fully_derived_B: Still possible as a different architecture, but would need to explicitly preserve the ratified reference's role (for example, constraint or independent reference) rather than silently replace it.

global_nodal_payload_authority.canonical_physical_state: Not preferred: would duplicate the independently governed continental reference plus ocean primitive/model inputs, unless later ARCANA explicitly elects an immutable authored nodal flux field as a new canonical realization.
global_nodal_payload_authority.derived_replayable_t0_state: Preferred for the complete cell/node global flux result if deterministically reproducible from the continental reference, ocean age/domain state, pinned specialist model/configuration and projection lineage. Preserve it in history as derived state with hashes, uncertainty and authority metadata, not as an independent canonical primitive.
global_nodal_payload_authority.numerical_runtime_input_only: The serialized FEG nodal array/file is this class: an adapter/runtime representation of the derived replayable T0 field. It is not itself canonical physical state.
global_nodal_payload_authority.replay_contract: Store/replay the model/configuration identity, all governed parent hashes, projection method/version, lineage and derived output hash; do not duplicate as new independent canon.
